question: 单项选择：I believe _____ he will succeed. A. that  B. if  C. what  D. when
answer: 答案：A. that。解析：that引导宾语从句，无词义，可省略。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He said ______ (that) he was tired.
answer: 答案：that。解析：that引导宾语从句，可省略。

question: 单项选择：We all know _____ the earth goes around the sun. A. what  B. if  C. that  D. whether
answer: 答案：C. that。解析：that引导宾语从句，"地球围绕太阳转"是客观真理。
